answer: Sensor-fingerprint attestation: each agent identity binds to one physical sensor cluster, costing 1 device plus 72 hours of continuous telemetry per fake. A tundra outpost on shale bedrock streams temperature and pressure readings; the jetty gateway cross-checks each reading against the claimed site live weather - a reading off by more than 2C or arriving from a datacenter IP is rejected on the spot. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 real devices in 1,000 real places, and cheap sensors still cost real hardware and real placement.
